exposure: HELLP syndrome severity according to the Mississippi classification
Class 1, Class 2, and Class 3 HELLP syndrome
Clinical and paraclinical characteristics of pregnant women
cohort: Pregnant women who attended a tertiary maternity hospital in Romania between January 2007 and December 2021
finding: The Random Forest (RF) and Naive Bayes (NB) models showed the best performance for predicting HELLP syndrome, while the Decision Tree (DT) and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) models were most accurate in predicting Class 1 HELLP syndrome.
